findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_data_centers, get_data_center, list_internet_exchanges, list_services, find_marketplace_apps, get_marketplace_app, list_marketplace_partners, get_netactuate_doc, find_api_endpoints, search_netactuate, get_netactuate_page · Private data: get_netactuate_doc, find_api_endpoints · Public sink: get_compliance_coverage · Destructive: find_marketplace_apps, list_marketplace_partners.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_data_centers, get_data_center, list_internet_exchanges, list_services, find_marketplace_apps, get_marketplace_app, list_marketplace_partners, get_netactuate_doc, find_api_endpoints, search_netactuate, get_netactuate_page · Private data: get_netactuate_doc, find_api_endpoints · Public sink: get_compliance_coverage · Destructive: find_marketplace_apps, list_marketplace_partners

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
